name: DegreeStep
tagline: The world’s scholarships, one step away

adsense._help: Leave client empty until AdSense gives you a publisher ID (ca-pub-...). With a client set, the build adds the AdSense tag, the site-verification meta tag and ads.txt. Slots are the numeric ad-unit IDs you create in AdSense > Ads > By ad unit; a bay whose slot is empty is not rendered.

premium._help: Leave gumroad_product_id empty and the calendar, compare and planner tools are free for everyone. Fill both fields to put them behind a Gumroad license key.
